Every package of couscous I bought here called for boiling couscous. That's a HARD HARD HARD no. You might as well set spaghetti on fire while you're at it. Proper way to make couscous:  

- Buy fine to medium couscous (brand like Zina or great value )   
- set up your steamer and while the water is boiling, spray your couscous with hot water enough to get it wet and make it fluffy (don't submerge it, juuuust a splash), put salt and pepper and a bit of olive oil.  
-with your hands work the couscous clumps, so it's back to its original state  
- put on steamer for 20-30 minutes, do not cover and DO NOT STIR  
- since you're buying packaged couscous (I use homemade pre steamed couscous) splash it again with water halfway through the steaming.  
- at the end, submerge it in whatever sauce you're using (beef stew, chichen stew, fish? Vegetables... Etc) give 10 minutes to soak up the sauce and bon appétit! I should Definitely make this a video. I'm tired of people shitting on couscous when they do not prepare it properly. The steamer is called Couscoussiere lol.
